title: Ling Long: 17 Fenzhong Zhengshi PV

alternative_titles.en: Ling Cage: Incarnation-17 Minutes Official PV

synopsis:
In the near future, the world becomes too crowded to sustain human development and the urge for human beings to search and move to a new home is imminent. Just as everything is going at order, the earth undergoes severe geological changes for decades and only a few humanity survive the catastrophe. As the world gradually regains peace, humans begin to resettle on the land but find themselves no longer the masters of the world.

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
